intro: Frostmane Hold is an Alliance recon mission assigned by Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos. Having tracked the hostile Frostmane trolls to their heavily guarded cavern stronghold near Iceflow Lake, Senir enlists adventurous scouts to brave the interior, eliminate their headhunters, and supply vital intel for his scouting reports.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, friend. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.
Here's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.

Take the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You can't find it? My directions were very clear! We don't have much time, you've got to hurry! Don't come back until you've found the cave.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, friend! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...
Let me just finish up my report then.
There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, friend, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
